Journal publisher states CC BY 4.0. The journal gives greenwashing directly under this sense; Dictionary.com independently explains the deceptive environmental-image noun and identifies its present form as greenwash + -ing, with greenwash linked to green and (white)wash or (brain)wash. Its lexicographic discussion recognizes the -washing element across this and greenwashing. A public policy research report independently distinguishes environmental claims from sport as the medium for reputational distraction. The example supports the general misleading-image sense, but a sport event need not itself assert environmental protection, ethical progress, or an explicit lie. Describe distraction from adverse conduct as the relevant typical usage, without implying that every sports sponsorship is deceptive.
